c1.note: composite: scene_review --wrist v2 --wrist_blur gripper. Region masks come from the sim; where the sim draws an object off the real one (D1), its region mixes look and placement.

c2.note: (a) counts: one detector call per noun on our composite and on the real frame, robot masked; ghost_suspect = more instances on our composite than both the sim objects visible and the real frame; unbuilt_or_false_positive = an extra instance on both our composite and the real frame. (b) residue: magenta = background pixels (away from sim and real foreground) differing by > 40/255 after exposure matching.

c3.note: observed = texel seen in a real wrist frame (not LaMa-filled); table_tex_wrist.npz 'observed'

c4.note: fit_iou: overlap of the real dark mask with the sim shadow at the fitted light (res31's fits); best_minus_second: gap to the runner-up direction (small = flat optimum, the direction is a guess); shadow_share: share of visible table pixels (robot/objects excluded) darker than 0.85x their 31-px neighbourhood median (sharp shadows); broad_ = darker than 0.85x the visible table's median (wide shadows; also counts darker wood), at the policy's size.
